result.brief: 提出 Agent-State LAM，联合学习紧凑智能体状态表征与潜动作建模，并用空间匹配时序判别（SMTD）抑制背景与外观干扰，提升动作恢复、下游控制与世界模型预测。
result.reason: Proposes agent-state latent action model with compact state representation learned via spatially matched temporal discrimination, improving world-model pretraining and control; core representation contribution.
